title: Hailed as Muhammad Ali’s toughest opponent, his biggest fight was outside the ring
summary_full: Canadian boxer George Chuvalo, who has died at 89, lost his wife and three sons to suicide and heroin. He channeled his grief into an anti-drug campaign.
